Class AbstractProjectContextProvider

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.event.BasicPropertyChangeSource
uno.anahata.asi.agi.context.BasicContextProvider
uno.anahata.asi.toolkit.project.AbstractProjectContextProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public abstract class AbstractProjectContextProvider extends BasicContextProvider
Universal base class for project and module context providers across all IDE and desktop environments.

Manages physical project root directory paths, hierarchical scope inheritance (via ProjectStructureScope), and lifecycle synchronization of project-specific system instructions (anahata.md).

  • Constructor Details

    • AbstractProjectContextProvider

      public AbstractProjectContextProvider(String id, String name, String description, ContextProvider parentProvider, String projectPath)
      Constructs a new project or module context provider associated with a parent provider.

      Immediately initializes the parent hierarchy reference so that BasicContextProvider.getAgi() and getEffectiveScope() resolve cleanly during construction without timing windows.

      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier for this provider.
      name - The human-readable name.
      description - A brief description of the provided context.
      parentProvider - The parent context provider (e.g. AbstractProjects or a parent project node).
      projectPath - The absolute path to the project root directory.

  • Method Details

    • setScope

      public void setScope(ProjectStructureScope scope)
      Sets the local structure scope override for this project or module. Fires a "projectStructureScope" property change event.
      Parameters:
      scope - The new granularity scope settings, or null to inherit.

    • getEffectiveScope

      public ProjectStructureScope getEffectiveScope()
      Resolves the effective ProjectStructureScope hierarchically.

      1. Returns local scope if explicitly configured on this node.
      2. Delegates to parent AbstractProjectContextProvider if nested (e.g. IntelliJ modules).
      3. Falls back to AbstractProjects.defaultScope from the toolkit (e.g. NetBeans workspace default).
      4. Defaults to standard ProjectStructureScope.

      Returns:
      The non-null effective ProjectStructureScope.

    • setProviding

      public void setProviding(boolean enabled)
      Sets whether this context provider is enabled.

      Updates providing state and synchronizes the project's anahata.md instructions file.

      Parameters:
      enabled - true to enable, false to disable.

    • syncMdResource

      protected void syncMdResource()
      Synchronizes the project or module's anahata.md instructions file with the session's resource manager to reflect this provider's active state.

      When providing, ensures anahata.md exists (creating a default stub if needed) and registers it at the ContextPosition.SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS context position; when not providing, unregisters it.

    • extractFirstSentence

      public static String extractFirstSentence(String docComment)
      Extracts the first sentence from a Javadoc or Markdown comment string, stripping HTML tags, asterisks, and Markdown link/formatting markers.
      Parameters:
      docComment - The raw Javadoc or Markdown comment text.
      Returns:
      The sanitized first sentence, or null if empty.
